item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\n\\ndef check(req, pol, exp):\\n    req0, pol0 = copy.deepcopy(req), copy.deepcopy(pol)\\n    got = evaluate(req, pol)\\n    assert got == exp, (got, exp)\\n    assert req == req0 and pol == pol0\\n\\np = {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':True}\\ncheck({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':100,'unit':'cm'},{'id':'b','amount':2}]},p,{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':1.0,'unit':'m'},{'id':'b','amount':2,'unit':'m'}],'errors':[]})\\ncheck({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':-1},{'id':'x','amount':2}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'duplicate'}]})\\ncheck({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':1},{'id':'x','amount':-1,'unit':'bad'}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':1,'cause':'amount'}]})\\ncheck({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':1},{'id':'x','amount':2,'unit':'bad'}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':1,'cause':'unit'}]})\\ncheck({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':-1,'unit':'bad'}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'}]})\\ncheck({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':True},{'id':'b','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'c','amount':float('nan')}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'}]})\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report == [evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests]\\nprint('checks passed')\"]}"}
